title: OpenKruise kruise-manager exposes an unauthenticated ppof endpoint when enabled, opening it on 0.0.0.0:8090, which can…
description: OpenKruise's kruise-manager component exposes an unauthenticated ppof endpoint on all network interfaces (0.0.0.0) at port 8090 when enabled. This exposure allows any pod with RBAC permissions to trigger a denial-of-service (DoS) attack against the service.
